blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) has adopted a historic regional policy initiative led by the Philippines to ensure that children across Southeast Asia gain strong foundational literacy, numeracy, and socio-emotional skills. According to a statement issued by the Department of Education (DepEd) on Monday, the Asean Declaration on Foundational Learning (ADFL), developed under its leadership during the Philippine Asean chairship, makes basic learning a shared priority for the entire region. The declaration was formally adopted during the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits in Manila, led by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. under the Philippine chairship theme, […]...
